name: Navigation
summary: Navigation for the AhaSlides marketing sites: the site navbar, a dark participant join bar that scrolls away above a sticky white navigation with mega-menus, collapsing to a hamburger drawer at 991px and below.
highlights: Join bar scrolls away, the navigation stays stuck to the top
Mega-menus open on hover with a fade and slide, the chevron turns; Products has three columns and a preview slot, Solutions has use cases and integration logos, Resources two columns
Hamburger drawer at 991px and below slides down; its menus are an accordion; the language menu opens on click

Brand mark is <aha-product-lockup>, icons are <aha-icon> by name, integration logos come from the Logo library; Log in and Sign up are <aha-button variant="secondary|primary" size="lg" href> and Join is <aha-button size="sm" type="submit">, with no button CSS of their own
Webflow component Header, variant name "Variant" (Pattern / Marketing / Header), matched to the live ahaslides.com at 1440px and 390px
layoutsIntro: The site navbar is one block: the class names below are scoped to it, so it can sit in any page.
